source_quote: In the Manchester tender, New Bank had 7 bids, Charlestown 6, Simpson 8, City Health Centre 11; GTD won four Manchester lots, Northern Health GPPO won Victoria Mill, Hope Citadel won Droylsden and Hawthorn, and Rochdale Health Alliance won the Bolton and HMR lots.

profiles.summary: Main anchor operator for this project: a not-for-profit, social-enterprise-style provider with GP practices, urgent care, central triage/co-ordination functions, and wider commissioned services.
profiles.legal_shape: Publicly presented as a not-for-profit, values-led organisation with a social enterprise ethos; Our People's Trust is presented as the single shareholder.
profiles.why_it_matters: This is the provider running New Bank and the main reference point for the org navigator, competitor comparison and pressure mapping work.
notes: The repo-local inquiry and operating-environment notes show GTD as more than a surgery chain: it also has a 24/7 clinical/co-ordination layer, referral triage functions and rapid-mobilisation work.
The same notes also place GTD inside GMUPCA and wider regional procurement / risk-bearing patterns.

profiles.summary: Registered-provider shell used in the public record for GTD-run services even where procurement documents name GTD Healthcare Ltd as contract holder.
profiles.legal_shape: Active company / provider shell visible in Companies House and CQC records.
profiles.relationship_to_gtd: Corporate delivery entity / registered-provider layer inside the GTD structure.
profiles.why_it_matters: The New Bank trail repeatedly splits contract award, CQC registration and corporate identity across GTD Healthcare Ltd and GoToDoc Ltd.
notes: This is part of why 'who won the contract?' and 'who runs the service?' are not always answered by the same legal entity in public records.

profiles.summary: Previous operator context for New Bank before the April 2025 move to GTD.
profiles.legal_shape: Previous provider context in repo-local handover notes; external profile is not yet fully curated in this folder.
profiles.why_it_matters: The org navigator will need to show that New Bank's current issues sit inside a longer operator history rather than starting from zero on 1 April 2025.
notes: Useful mainly as handover context and for separating pre-GTD from post-GTD evidence.

profiles.summary: North Manchester GP federation and not-for-profit membership organisation that appears both as a federation layer and as a real peer / tender actor.
profiles.relationship_to_gtd: Competitor in Manchester APMS / SAS contexts; collaborator-adjacent in the wider Manchester provider ecosystem.
profiles.why_it_matters: It won Victoria Mill in the Manchester APMS round and later took over Manchester SAS work from GTD.
notes: In the current dataset it appears as an affiliated group rather than a direct management-company match.
This is one of the clearest examples of a body that is not just 'near GTD' but is an actual substitute / alternative operator in some commissioner decisions.
